title: elaeagnus × ebbingei
intro: Elaeagnus × ebbingei, commonly known as the Silverberry or Gilt-Edged Silverbush, is a hybrid plant species belonging to the Elaeagnaceae family. The Silverberry plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its antioxidant properties, which help protect against cell damage and inflammation. Its therapeutic actions include reducing stress, improving sleep quality, and providing relief from anxiety and depression, mainly due to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive constituents also exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities, which contribute to the plant's overall therapeutic potential.
